description: Verified exam-focused notes for 30 October 2026 covering agriculture, labour governance, fiscal accounts, responsible AI, air quality, pension services, defence technology, enforcement, culture and railways.

stories.title: PM-KISAN 24th instalment transfers over ₹18,690 crore
stories.summary: The Union Government released the 24th instalment of PM-KISAN at Banaskantha, Gujarat, transferring more than ₹18,690 crore to about 9.34 crore eligible farmer families through Direct Benefit Transfer. The release took cumulative disbursements under the scheme beyond ₹4.64 lakh crore.
key_facts: PM-KISAN provides eligible farmer families ₹6,000 a year in three instalments of ₹2,000 each.
The 24th instalment was released on 30 October 2026 through Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
Land-record seeding, Aadhaar linkage and e-KYC are used for beneficiary verification.
The Union Budget 2026–27 allocated ₹60,000 crore for PM-KISAN.
stories.exam_link: Revise Central Sector schemes, Direct Benefit Transfer, Aadhaar-enabled verification and the distinction between income support and crop-price support.

stories.title: National Social Security Board notified for informal and gig workers
stories.summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment notified the constitution of the National Social Security Board for unorganised workers and gig and platform workers under the Code on Social Security. The Board is intended to recommend, monitor and support targeted welfare measures; its creation does not itself replace individual social-security schemes.
key_facts: The Union Minister for Labour and Employment will chair the Board.
Its membership includes representatives of Central and State governments, employers, aggregators, workers and civil society.
The institutional framework explicitly brings gig and platform workers into national social-security deliberations.
The Board's functions are recommendatory and monitoring-oriented rather than judicial.
stories.exam_link: Study the Code on Social Security, 2020, unorganised workers, gig workers, platform workers and the difference between statutory boards and implementing agencies.
stories.source_title: National Social Security Board notification — PIB, 30 October 2026

stories.title: TRAI releases draft responsible-AI guidelines for telecom
stories.summary: TRAI placed draft guidelines on the responsible use of artificial intelligence in telecom networks and services before stakeholders. The draft seeks sector-specific clarity, predictability and accountability while applying the principles of the India AI Governance Guidelines. Written comments are invited by 27 November 2026, so the document is not yet final regulation.
key_facts: The framework covers AI use in both telecommunication networks and provision of telecommunication services.
Its seven guiding sutras include trust, people first, fairness, accountability, understandable design and safety.
Telecom networks support essential services, commerce, emergency response and critical information infrastructure.
TRAI is a statutory regulator created under the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997.
stories.exam_link: Connect sectoral AI governance with telecom regulation, critical information infrastructure, consumer protection, explainability and regulatory consultation.
stories.source_title: Draft Guidelines on Responsible Use of AI in Telecom — PIB/TRAI, 30 October 2026

stories.title: Union accounts show receipts at 50.3% of Budget Estimates
stories.summary: The Controller General of Accounts' monthly review reported Union Government receipts of ₹18,35,422 crore up to September 2026, equal to 50.3% of the corresponding Budget Estimate for FY 2026–27. Total expenditure was ₹25,49,835 crore, or 47.7% of Budget Estimates, with separate reporting of revenue and capital expenditure.
key_facts: Net tax revenue to the Centre was ₹12,76,088 crore and non-tax revenue was ₹4,80,732 crore.
Non-debt capital receipts amounted to ₹78,602 crore.
Revenue expenditure was ₹18,95,288 crore, while capital expenditure was ₹6,54,547 crore.
Tax devolution to States reached ₹6,99,409 crore, ₹67,658 crore more than in the previous year.
stories.exam_link: Revise Budget Estimates, revenue and capital expenditure, tax devolution, non-debt capital receipts and the Consolidated Fund of India.
stories.source_title: Monthly Review of Government of India Accounts up to September 2026 — PIB, 30 October 2026

stories.title: CAQM reviews PAVAN-I3C real-time air-quality platform
stories.summary: The Environment Minister reviewed PAVAN-I3C, the Commission for Air Quality Management's integrated command centre for Delhi-NCR. The platform combines air-quality, emissions, weather, satellite, camera, mobility, complaint and compliance feeds to support alert-based enforcement and faster response to local pollution spikes.
key_facts: PAVAN expands to Platform for Air Quality Vigilance and Analytics for NCR.
The command centre integrates more than 30 APIs and data streams.
It connects data from 111 continuous air-quality stations, over 2,300 industries and more than 3,200 active construction sites.
Its operating principle is Detect, Analyse and Act, with deviations triggering alerts to the responsible agency.
stories.exam_link: Revise the CAQM Act, 2021, Delhi-NCR air governance, continuous ambient-air monitoring, industrial emissions and inter-State environmental coordination.
stories.source_title: Environment Minister Reviews CAQM's PAVAN-I3C — PIB, 30 October 2026

stories.title: Digital Life Certificate Campaign 5 targets 2.30 crore certificates
stories.summary: The Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare announced Nationwide Digital Life Certificate Campaign 5 for 1–30 November 2026. The scheduled campaign will promote face authentication, camps and doorstep services so pensioners can submit life certificates without unnecessary physical visits. Its targets are prospective and had not been completed on the announcement date.
key_facts: Camps are planned across 2,000 cities and districts.
The campaign targets 2.30 crore digital life certificates, including 1.50 crore through face authentication.
Participants include 19 banks, 785 district post offices, 56 pensioners' associations, UIDAI and MeitY teams.
Jeevan Pramaan is the digital life-certificate system used by pensioners.
stories.exam_link: Revise digital public services, biometric and face authentication, India Post Payments Bank, pension administration and inclusion of elderly citizens.
stories.source_title: Nationwide Digital Life Certificate Campaign 5 — PIB, 30 October 2026

stories.title: VISV-2026 highlights co-development in defence technology
stories.summary: The Minister of State for Defence inaugurated VISV-2026, organised by DRDO with the Centre for Joint Warfare Studies in New Delhi. The forum showcased indigenous defence solutions and explored technical exchanges, product adaptation, co-development, co-production and manufacturing partnerships with friendly countries.
key_facts: VISV stands for Vision, Innovation, Synergy and Values.
The event theme was Showcasing Defence Capabilities, Strengthening Global Partnerships.
A DRDO product compendium was released in Arabic, Spanish and French for engagement with international partners.
The programme included defence attachés, diplomatic missions, the Armed Forces, industry and academia.
stories.exam_link: Study DRDO, defence indigenisation, strategic autonomy, defence diplomacy and the difference between exports, licensed production, co-production and co-development.
stories.source_title: VISV-2026 on Defence Capabilities and Global Partnerships — PIB, 30 October 2026

stories.title: DRI reports 50 kg methamphetamine seizure in the North-East
stories.summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence reported two intelligence-led operations in Mizoram and Assam that seized 50 kg of suspected methamphetamine in tablet and crystal form. Four persons were arrested under the NDPS Act and three vehicles were seized. The release describes an ongoing investigation and preliminary Myanmar links, not a final judicial finding.
key_facts: The seizures comprised 30 kg of methamphetamine tablets and 20 kg of crystal methamphetamine.
DRI officers received operational assistance from Assam Rifles.
One consignment was concealed in furniture and another in tea packets bearing foreign markings.
DRI functions under the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs in the Department of Revenue.
stories.exam_link: Revise the NDPS Act, DRI, CBIC, Assam Rifles, the India–Myanmar border and the distinction between seizure, arrest, prosecution and conviction.
stories.source_title: DRI Seizes Myanmar-Linked Methamphetamine Consignments — PIB, 30 October 2026

stories.title: Piprahwa Buddha relics scheduled for Arunachal exposition
stories.summary: The Culture Ministry announced an exposition of the sacred Piprahwa relics of Shakyamuni Buddha in Arunachal Pradesh from 31 October to 21 November 2026. The planned itinerary covers Tawang, Bomdila and Namsai and includes an exhibition on the relics' discovery and repatriation. The announcement concerned a future schedule, not a completed exposition.
key_facts: The relics are preserved at the National Museum in New Delhi.
The first venue is Gaden Namgyal Lhatse, commonly known as Tawang Monastery.
The itinerary then moves to Bomdila and the Golden Pagoda at Namsai.
The programme includes an international conference on Buddhism in the Himalayan region and beyond.
stories.exam_link: Revise Buddhist relic traditions, Piprahwa, Tawang Monastery, Arunachal Pradesh's cultural geography and India's Buddhist diplomacy.
stories.source_title: Holy Relics of Lord Buddha Exposition in Arunachal Pradesh — PIB, 30 October 2026

stories.title: Varanasi–New Delhi Vande Bharat Sleeper service announced
stories.summary: Indian Railways announced that new Vande Bharat Sleeper Express services between Varanasi and New Delhi would be flagged off on 31 October 2026. The release described a planned overnight service linking major Uttar Pradesh cities with the national capital; it should not be treated as operational before the scheduled flag-off.
key_facts: The route includes Prayagraj, Kanpur Central, Aligarh and Ghaziabad.
The announced Varanasi departure is 20:50 with New Delhi arrival at 06:10 the next morning.
The return service is scheduled to leave New Delhi at 21:40 and reach Varanasi at 07:10.
The service follows the introduction of Vande Bharat Sleeper trains on the Howrah–Guwahati corridor in January 2026.
stories.exam_link: Revise railway zones and corridors, Varanasi and Prayagraj geography, semi-high-speed rail modernisation and the distinction between announcement, flag-off and regular operation.
stories.source_title: Varanasi–New Delhi Vande Bharat Sleeper Announcement — PIB, 30 October 2026

mcqs.question: Under PM-KISAN, an eligible farmer family normally receives how much income support each year?
mcqs.explanation: PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000 annually in three equal instalments of ₹2,000.

mcqs.question: Approximately how many farmer families received the 24th PM-KISAN instalment released on 30 October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The release reported about 9.34 crore eligible beneficiaries and a transfer exceeding ₹18,690 crore.

mcqs.question: The notified National Social Security Board derives its current statutory framework from which law?
mcqs.explanation: The Board for unorganised and gig or platform workers was notified under the Code on Social Security.

mcqs.question: Who is to chair the National Social Security Board described in the 30 October notification?
mcqs.explanation: The Union Minister for Labour and Employment is to preside over the Board.

options: A draft open for stakeholder consultation

mcqs.question: Which expenditure category totalled approximately ₹6.55 lakh crore up to September 2026?

mcqs.explanation: The defence forum identified Vision, Innovation, Synergy and Values as its four pillars.
